import Foundation

public struct MCPEndpointConfig: Sendable, Codable, Equatable {
    public let url: URL
    public let providerID: ProviderID

    public init(url: URL, providerID: ProviderID) {
        self.url = url
        self.providerID = providerID
    }
}

public struct AppConfig: Sendable, Codable, Equatable {
    public let summarization: SummaryConfig
    public let transcription: TranscriptionConfig
    public let storage: StorageConfig
    public let translation: TranslationConfig
    public let contextCache: ContextCacheConfig
    public let audioCapture: AudioCaptureConfig
    public let uiTheme: UITheme
    public let privacyMode: PrivacyMode
    /// Whether the user has consented to sending transcript data to MCP providers.
    /// Persisted across launches. Defaults to `false`.
    public let mcpConsentGranted: Bool
    /// MCP provider endpoints to wire at startup. Empty by default.
    public let mcpEndpoints: [MCPEndpointConfig]
    /// Whether the Notion context provider is enabled. Defaults to `false`.
    public let notionEnabled: Bool
    /// File-system path to the Obsidian vault. `nil` means Obsidian provider is disabled.
    public let obsidianVaultPath: String?

    public static let `default` = AppConfig(
        summarization: .default,
        transcription: .default,
        storage: .default,
        translation: .disabled,
        contextCache: .default,
        audioCapture: .default,
        uiTheme: .default,
        privacyMode: .default,
        mcpConsentGranted: false,
        mcpEndpoints: [],
        notionEnabled: false,
        obsidianVaultPath: nil
    )

    public init(
        summarization: SummaryConfig, transcription: TranscriptionConfig,
        storage: StorageConfig, translation: TranslationConfig = .disabled,
        contextCache: ContextCacheConfig = .default,
        audioCapture: AudioCaptureConfig = .default,
        uiTheme: UITheme = .default,
        privacyMode: PrivacyMode = .default,
        mcpConsentGranted: Bool = false,
        mcpEndpoints: [MCPEndpointConfig] = [],
        notionEnabled: Bool = false,
        obsidianVaultPath: String? = nil
    ) {
        self.summarization = summarization
        self.transcription = transcription
        self.storage = storage
        self.translation = translation
        self.contextCache = contextCache
        self.audioCapture = audioCapture
        self.uiTheme = uiTheme
        self.privacyMode = privacyMode
        self.mcpConsentGranted = mcpConsentGranted
        self.mcpEndpoints = mcpEndpoints
        self.notionEnabled = notionEnabled
        self.obsidianVaultPath = obsidianVaultPath
    }

    public init(from decoder: any Decoder) throws {
        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)
        summarization = try container.decode(SummaryConfig.self, forKey: .summarization)
        transcription = try container.decode(TranscriptionConfig.self, forKey: .transcription)
        storage = try container.decode(StorageConfig.self, forKey: .storage)
        translation = try container.decodeIfPresent(TranslationConfig.self, forKey: .translation) ?? .disabled
        contextCache = try container.decodeIfPresent(ContextCacheConfig.self, forKey: .contextCache) ?? .default
        audioCapture = try container.decodeIfPresent(AudioCaptureConfig.self, forKey: .audioCapture) ?? .default
        uiTheme = try container.decodeIfPresent(UITheme.self, forKey: .uiTheme) ?? .default
        privacyMode = try container.decodeIfPresent(PrivacyMode.self, forKey: .privacyMode) ?? .default
        mcpConsentGranted = try container.decodeIfPresent(Bool.self, forKey: .mcpConsentGranted) ?? false
        mcpEndpoints = try container.decodeIfPresent([MCPEndpointConfig].self, forKey: .mcpEndpoints) ?? []
        notionEnabled = try container.decodeIfPresent(Bool.self, forKey: .notionEnabled) ?? false
        obsidianVaultPath = try container.decodeIfPresent(String.self, forKey: .obsidianVaultPath)
    }
}
